+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build an expense tracker: description, amount, category Food/Transport/Housing/Fun/Other, date, total spent, filter by category, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores expenses. A database module offers add, list, update, delete, and total functions. FastAPI routes under /api/expenses call them. A single HTML page lists expenses with coloured category badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each. The total spent is computed and displayed above the list.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Expense tracker
+
+Record what you spend, group it by category, and see the total.
+
+**expenses**: description (string), amount (number), category (Food / Transport / Housing / Fun / Other), date (string). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add an expense with description, amount, category and date
+- List of expenses showing every field, with a coloured category badge
+- Total spent shown above the list
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every expense
+- Filter the list by category
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/expenses`: Add an expense
+- `GET /api/expenses`: List all expenses, newest first
+- `PUT /api/expenses/{id}`: Edit one expense
+- `DELETE /api/expenses/{id}`: Delete one expense
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with description, amount, category select (Food, Transport, Housing, Fun, Other), date input, and a Save button
+- List of expenses showing description, amount, category badge, date, and a coloured category badge
+- Total spent displayed above the list
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every expense
+- Filter the list by category
+- Show error messages from the API
